chapters.content:
Xue Yao maintained the position of holding the toy wooden carriage high above his head, motionless, with a serious expression as if he was about to stand up and blow up a bunker.
There was the sound of a group of boys laughing and joking around them, and the sound of a young child crying.
As his mind gradually cleared, the last memory in Xue Yao's mind was the roar of the airplane before it crashed.
He needed to find a quiet place to think about the current situation, so he put down the toy wooden horse he had raised above his head, his arms a little sore.
A boy's displeased voice came, "What's the dilly-dallying! Ah Yao? Drop it!"
Ah Yao? Is it calling out to him?
Xue Yao looked blankly at the person who had called him Ah Yao, a child.
Twisting his head to look around, a group of children.
Xue Yao's eyes gradually widened.
Why are all these kids dressed up in costume?
The boy who called him Ayao was about ten years old, wearing a vermillion straightjacket, with fair skin, fine features, and thin single eyelids slightly squinted, revealing a domineering meanness.
"What are you fuming about?" Seeing that Xue Yao still didn't make a move to wrestle the wooden horse, the Third Prince stepped forward and waved his hand, ready to do it himself.
Xue Yao murmured in confusion, "What are you guys ......"
He suddenly choked on the words before they were finished.
Why does he have a child's voice?
He looked down at his body incredulously, and sure enough, it was the body of a child.
Is this a dream?
Gradually, the cries of a strange toddler approached.
Xue Yao followed the sound and lowered his head, just to see a three or four year old toddler running to him, bending down as if he were a small penguin, trying very hard to pick up the toy wooden horse on the ground.
Seeing that the little wooden horse was about to be lifted up by the young children, the Third Prince suddenly detached himself from Xue Yao, stepped forward, kicked the wooden horse, and laughed loudly, "Aiya! Old Seven's little wooden horse has fallen and its ears are broken!"
The toddler sniffed nervously and hung his little head down to take a look, realizing that his toy wooden horse had indeed lost one of its ears, and burst into whimpering tears.
"Old Seven is crying!" The Third Prince got more and more excited, took a step over the small wooden horse, bent down and stepped on the horse's tail, and coaxed, "The small wooden horse's tail is broken!"
The toddler rubbed his eyes as he cried, glanced at the disconnected ponytail, and let out another louder cry.
His cries never drew comfort from those around him, so with open little fat arms, he snapped and ran to the surrounding courtesans, taking turns begging for a hug.
The delicate features of the young child some mixed flavor, long eyelashes under the tearful eyes, small mouth aggrieved straight aside, that little look weak, poor, and obese, simply call people heartbreak.
The palace maids, however, bowed their heads and stepped back, not daring to mind their own business.
This young child is a Persian dancer for the emperor gave birth to the seventh prince, although his mother consort is very popular with the Holy Spirit, but after all, mixed with foreign blood, the future of a gray, no one dares to offend the third prince for him.
Xue Yao's foggy brain grasped the name "Old Seven".
He remembered the Dragon Ao Tian novel that he had stayed up late last night on the airplane to finish reading, and the male protagonist was the seventh prince, Lu Qian, who was often referred to as Old Seven by his brothers.
So, was he dreaming? Dreaming about the plot of that novel.
Since it was a dream, Xue Yao once again lowered his head and looked earnestly at the Seventh Prince.
Worthy of being Dragon Ao Tian Bentian, the cub stage had grown such a woeful little face, even exceeding the face value Xue Yao had brainstormed while reading the book, and it was estimated that if the novel was made into a TV series in the future, he would not be able to find such a suitable brat to play the role.
Thinking he was dreaming, Xue Yao missed his last chance to survive, failed to help, and became one of the members of the Trojan Horse of Ruin, and was remembered in the shadow zone of the Seventh Prince's young mind.
The seventh prince who couldn't beg for a hug snapped and ran away to tell his mother!
In the half hour or so that followed, the confusing memories in Xue Yao's head gradually cleared up.
The owner of this body is also called Xue Yao, born in the 13th year of Lin An, eight years old this year, and is the servant reader of His Royal Highness the Third Prince.
Xue Yao is the son of the family, grandfather of the year the temple examination list and first, the official to the Ministry of Household, and then shade into the State Prison is the first son of the Xue family.
And Xue Yao's father is the third in line, can only participate in the imperial examinations themselves, Lin An two years in the third grade, currently in the Ministry of Ceremony to mix a mouthful of food.
Xue Yao's selection to be the Third Prince's companion was actually arranged by his father, Master Xue.
Master Xue thought that the Grand Prince was most likely to be made the Crown Prince, so he sent Xue Qiong, the first born of the Xue family, to the Grand Prince.
And the third prince also has five percent possibility to become the crown prince, because his mother consort's brother is the salt straight governor, in recent years in the coastal area fought two big victories, the scenery is infinite, and even the mother consort of the third prince is also therefore to get the holy favor.
Although it may only be a moment of scenery, Master Xue did not dare to neglect, so he sent the concubine Xue Yao to the side of the third prince.
In case the Grand Prince overturned, the Xue family was counting on Xue Yao to risk his life to advise and save the Xue family's beloved Xue Qiong.
In case the Third Prince flipped (which was certain as well as certain at the moment), the Xue family planned to break their wrists and sacrifice this well-behaved and understanding commoner son, Xue Yao.
This was all analyzed by Xue Yao based on the novel's description of this supporting character in only a few words, combined with the supporting character's own memories.
The original owner of this body, Xue Yao, was a genuine eight year old child, unsuspecting of the adults' arrangements, very much heeding his father's advice and faithfully following the Third Prince.
And Xue Yao remembered the ending of this cannon fodder in the novel: dying under the sword of King Ning on the day his men surrounded the palace.
In the novel, there is another graphic description of the death of this cannon fodder--
Xue Yao abandoned the Emperor in a critical situation and tried to escape through the west gate of the forbidden palace.
Fleeing to Xihua Yuan, Xue Yao suddenly saw purple shadows sweeping across his eyes, a long figure landing gently and slowly, holding a sword in one hand and standing with his back turned.
"The little wooden horse's ear fell out." The voice of the man with the sword was low and magnetic and pleasant to the ear, but it was wrapped in the silky chill of a viper spitting out its mail, he slowly turned around, a pair of deceivingly smiling eyes locking onto Xue Yao, and with a hook of his left lip, the sand and dust around him flew up, boiling with murderous intent.
Recognizing that the visitor was actually the King of Ning, Xue Yao panicked and stepped back, suddenly feeling a strong wind sweeping across his side face, he raised his hand to cover his side ear, only to realize that his ear had been cut off!
And a drop of blood dripped from the tip of King Ning's sword, piercingly crimson.
Xue Yao was like meeting a Cultivator Evil Ghost, so shocked that she backed up repeatedly, the Ning King in front of her suddenly disappeared, and the teasing voice rang out from behind her again, "The little wooden horse's tail is broken."
As soon as the words fell, a sharp sword stabbed into Xue Yao's tailbone, and the white bone came out of his raw wrist!
......
Recalling this episode, Xue Yao couldn't help but tighten his chrysanthemums.
I thought it was awesome when I was watching it, but now I just feel an earache, a pain in the ass, and a heartache!
Is this a dream or not?
Why does a dream make his mind so clear?
If it wasn't a dream, wouldn't it mean that he had traveled into the novel he was reading?
And just ten minutes ago, he witnessed the whole process of "the Seventh Prince's little wooden horse being broken by an ear and a tail"!
In the novel, Seventh Prince Ning's little wooden horse was lifted up and broken by Xue Yao herself, and the horse's tail was also stepped on and broken by Xue Yao at the behest of the Third Prince.
Because Xue Yao had just suddenly put on this body and was slow to react, the Third Prince was impatient and did these two things himself.
So, there was a right to grievances, would King Ning thus not bother with Xue Yao's ears and tail vertebrae?
Based on the persona in the novel, no way, Xue Yao is dead!
The Third Prince is dead.
The little followers who were screaming at the Third Prince's side just now are all dead.
Then can Xue Yao quit his status as a companion reader and travel far away from home, relying on the cultural knowledge of modern people to reign supreme in the Niujia Village and win the hearts of all the girls in the village?
Probably not, since it's a Dragon Pride novel.
Dragon Ao Tian novel we all understand, usually IQ even two hundred eight cannon fodder, a encounter with the protagonist, instantly down to two to eight, not to mention escape the palms of the protagonist, the protagonist does not look for him, he also took the initiative to look for it, death is the cannon fodder of the passive skills.
And the protagonist of the multi-intelligence near demon handsome fried sky, that are just the basic configuration, Ning Wang Lu Qian not only amazing force value, and cultivate the agent's eyes and ears all over the world, the information feedback speed is comparable to the telecom gigabit wireless network, there is not a villain can escape face!
Heavens, earth, if Xue Yao really died in a plane crash and crossed over, he should have been given a decent supporting role!
He has never done anything bad in his life ah, somehow suffered a plane crash is already bad enough, but also to wear a protagonist cut ear poke butt eighteen line cannon fodder!
Is there any justice!
Complaining won't solve the problem, we still need to understand the current living environment before analyzing it calmly, Xue Yao found an excuse to take leave and left the palace to return to his house.
The old master of the Xue family is still alive, so there is no separation of the family, the mansion is the ancestral inheritance of the four big house, with a large courtyard with small bridges and water.
Strolling through the copyhold veranda, the spring breeze from the courtyard brushed his face, Xue Yao's tangled mood was slightly soothed, and the original master's memories were almost straightened out.
Xue Yao's father is not a small official, is no oil and water, so the days of the older brother's family than the assault on the Ministry of households is much poorer.
The era of the novel is Daqi, similar to the Ming Dynasty, where officials' salaries are so low that corruption has a formal name, such as lower-level officials giving gifts to higher-level officials, once in the winter and once in the summer, called charcoal and ice, in addition to the three festivals and two birthdays, which are also routinely given.
Capital officials can not directly contact the people, woolgathering, living life all rely on the lower level officials agreed to a variety of filial piety.
But Master Xue's this official, the management of the correctional aspect, the contact object is mainly in the palace, the hands of the officials can not make oil and water, forced to clean.
The days are getting worse and worse, and they are all counting on the Xue family's youngest master, Xue Qiong, to assist the Grand Prince in his flight to heaven and bring the whole family with him.
Let's just say that this day's meal was the first time Xue Yao felt just how unaffluent the Xue family was.
Although there is no separation of the families, but the weekday meals are eaten by each family.
Xue Yao's family lived in the Xue Mansion's East Courtyard, and the only people at the dinner table were Master Xue, Mrs. Chen, and the two young masters.
The first young master is the first born Xue Qiong, who just turned ten this year, and the second young master is Xue Yao.
Xue Yao's own mother, Aunt Zhou, could not join her at the table and had to be on the sidelines, serving the Master and Mistress with the maids.
Today there was a pheasant soup, a flavorful stew with two tender, fatty chicken thighs.
In accordance with international practice, Auntie Zhou fished one chicken leg into the Master's bowl, while the other one was to be given to the Mrs.
But Mrs. said she had bad teeth and couldn't eat it, so naturally the chicken leg was given to her son, Xue Qiong.
On the opposite side of the table, Xue Yao let out a "gulp" and gulped.
Before he wore it, he was tired of eating chicken legs, and now that he had eaten cabbage in clear soup for two days, the flavor of the chicken legs smelled, like abalone, and Xue Yao's eight year old gluttony simply could not resist the temptation.
Master Xue, still a bit of a father, heard his youngest son swallowing and looked at the chicken thighs in the bowl of soup in front of him, so he said, "I don't have very good teeth either, so this ......"
Xue Yao was just about to be grateful when Xue Qiong, his elder brother beside him, finished gnawing on a chicken leg quickly and raised his hand with a mouth full of grease, "My child has good teeth! I'll eat it on behalf of my father!"
This was said as if he was trying to suffer, Xue Yao could not let him "suffer", and hurriedly scrambled to suffer for his father: "Big brother has already eaten one, so let me do it for him!"
Mrs. Chen saw this concubine pup dared not know good and bad, immediately spoke for her own son Xue Qiong: "Your elder brother recently accompanied the great prince to practice the sword, especially hard, naturally, you have to eat more meat to make up for it."
Master Xue gave a slight lurch, and the chicken leg that he had intended to push in front of his youngest son turned in the right direction.
Fairness was secondary, the eldest son was the sidekick of the prospective Crown Prince and the hope of the Xue family, so naturally he should be favored.
Master Xue did not read the script, did not know that in the end it was the third prince who was established, not to mention that the third prince's dragon chair was killed by the seventh prince before it was warmed up, and in his eyes, the eldest prince was the most promising, so the eldest son, Xue Qiong, was also the most promising.
Seeing that the chicken leg was about to be lost, Xue Yao had a brainwave and said to Master Xue, "Our Third Prince is being quizzed by the Emperor on the Four Books and the Five Classics all day long, it's quite hard, and the Emperor doesn't really supervise the Great Prince's sword practice anyway, so Big Brother can be lazy once in a while!"
Master Xue keenly raised his eyes to Xue Yao and asked, "His Majesty often quizzes the Third Prince on his learning?"
Xue Yao complained in a childish manner, "Yes~ The brothers in our courtyard have to be on their toes all the time!"
Xue Yao used his adult brain to easily figure out that, as a pawn of the Xue family, the chips for him to compete with Xue Qiong were never to be petulant and cute and play pitiful, but rather, the Third Prince was more favored by the Holy Spirit than the Grand Prince, and with the Third Prince in favor, the hope of the Xue family would be him, Xue Yao, rather than Xue Qiong.
As expected, as soon as this was said, Master Xue did not hesitate to push the chicken leg in front of Xue Yao, lovingly telling him to eat slowly, and adding that he would stew another chicken tomorrow if he loved it.
The battle for the chicken was easily won by Xue Yao.
However, after the meal, as soon as the master left, Mrs. Chen's face was as cold as an ice sculpture, and with a roll of her eyelids she glared at Auntie Zhou, sneering, "Really good at teaching her son, at a young age she has taught him to have a heart of gold, not distinguishing between the young and the old, and believing in what she says, so how can she expect him to do his filial duty?"
Aunt Zhou's face went white with fear, bowing and replying, "Concubine was negligent in disciplining Yao Ge'er, I ask Mistress to chastise her."
Xue Yao: "......"
Once upon a time, many aunts in novels rode on the head of the main house, how come it was his turn to cross the border and he ran into such an aunt with less than five combat power?
Aunt Zhou is considered a great beauty, in the memory of Xue Yao's body, the aunt is a very gentle and virtuous ancient women, exactly how to enter the Xue House, Xue Yao's original owner is still young, and there is no memory in this regard, only to know that Aunt Zhou usually treats herself as a slave, in front of Mrs. Chen, it is even shorter than several levels.
Mrs. Chen and Aunt Zhou are both victims of the ancient system of multiple concubine marriages, both are miserable, and as a matter of fact should not hurt each other anymore, but ......
Mrs. Chen coldly instructed Aunt Zhou, "Go to the ancestral hall and copy the scriptures to repent."
"Splat," Xue Yao, who was originally rambling, suddenly knelt down for Mrs. Chen! "Mother rest your anger, it's the child's fault."
Aunt Zhou looked over with tears in her eyes and said in a small, urgent voice: "It has nothing to do with you, quickly retreat, don't disturb the cleanliness of the wife!"
Xue Yao: "......"
Heaven bears witness that this sudden kneeling and admission of wrongdoing was not of his own volition!
As if it was an instinctive reaction from this body, he inexplicably did so!
Although he had no feelings for Aunt Zhou, this body and memories seemed to be deeply attached to his own mother and would unconsciously defend her.
Preferably out of affectionate memory, but don't you think this cannon fodder's body has some special setting that makes it act and say specific things when a specific event occurs?
For example, as soon as he saw the cub-aged little Ning King buy a new toy, Xue Yao couldn't help but run up and smash it or something ......
Then he is to grow two hundred pairs of ears and ten thousand tails, it is not enough for Long Ao Tian to cut!
The inner grass mud horse hadn't finished running, Xue Yao's ears suddenly rang a mechanical system prompt: [Whitewashing point +6, the villain as a personal system newbie tutorial is complete, warm reminder, whitewashing point reaches 50, you can open the exchange interface].

"Brother Yao'er is still a bit of a bearer." Mrs. Xue Yao casts a sidelong glance, "Considering that you are young and this is your first offense, I can't bear to punish you, I'll only deduct half a penny from you this month, so that you'll learn from your mistakes."
In modern times, Xue Yao's mother is Aunt Zhou, but in ancient times, the concubine's son should call the main wife his mother, and most people usually call her "Mrs.".
Ancient people's name is actually very good to understand, most of them are called with the subordinates, for example, Xue Yao's father is the third master of the Xue family, named Xue Cheng, the third house of the maids and boys called him "master" or "Cheng three masters," his son, his wife, his aunts and wives call him "master" on weekdays, and even the old master and the old lady also called him "master". The son, wife, aunts usually also call him "master", even the old master and the old lady also called him "master", which is called with the subordinate address.
Of course, the son can call him "father" and the parents can call him by his first name, depending on the family's customs.
This was the result of Xue Yao's observation over the past two days. After all, the original owner was an eight year old child who called himself by his customary name, but didn't know much about the rules, so he had to figure it out himself.
At the moment, Xue Yao was thinking about the system prompt just now, and didn't have the heart to think about how big of a punishment "deducting half of a month's money" was, so he directly kowtowed and agreed to it.
After Mrs. Zhou went back to her room, Aunt Zhou was heartbroken and pleased with her filial son, and busily took out the money she had saved between her teeth and handed it over to Xue Yao's personal maid, asking her not to save the food and drink for Yao's son when he went to the academy, and to make up for the lack of that half a hang of money.
If Xue Yao accepts her birth mother's money, I'm afraid that the six whitewashing points she just heard will be deducted back, so she hurriedly rejects Aunt Zhou's good intentions, saying that the palace academy will provide pastries, and that she doesn't need to bring her own food.
Aunt Zhou then stopped and praised him twice more before going back to her room to rest.
Xue Yao returned to the east wing, dismissed the maids, and began to study the "system prompt" alone.
He tried whispering the command, "Open the system interface," and heard no response, so he closed his eyes and mentally ordered it, and still got no response from the system.
As he recalled the mantra "villains make personal systems", a dark space suddenly appeared in his mind.
The space contained a three-dimensional giant Rubik's Cube, each square of which was translucent glass emanating a shimmering light.
Xue Yao tried to focus his mental energy on a small square of the Rubik's Cube, and the sight distance immediately drew closer, as if he were floating directly in front of that square.
There appeared to be some sort of object locked inside the square, but it was impossible to see it fully through the translucent glass.
Just now that system prompt said that the cleansing point reached 50 before the exchange interface could be opened.
He had just added only 6 points, so perhaps he wouldn't be able to unlock the Rubik's Cube at all, so Xue Yao had to call it quits for the time being, opening his eyes and exiting the mental space.
The mood is a little excited, this is obviously a golden finger ah, although for the time being do not know what use can be put, but at least gives him a little hope.
Since it's a "villain as a personal system", the so-called "whitewash points" must be earned by doing good deeds.
For now, it seemed that honoring his own mother was considered a whitewash, so should he send Auntie Zhou a quilt to try?
Xue Yao said to try, and ran both ways in the east wing and west wing in one night, serving tea and water and sending quilts, until it was dark, when he heard a beep: [Non-substantial help in the act of showmanship reaches three, whitewash point -1].
Xue Yao: "????"
What's with the demerits!
Showboating behavior? A bolt from the blue!
Is this system so real!
Xue Yao wilted in defeat.
Tossing and turning in the night, there were only two ways out that he could think of: one was to go and help the Seventh Prince to fix the ears and tail of the little wooden horse, and the other, counting on some life-saving magic treasures in this system exchange.
However, both paths are currently lost.
The Seventh Prince was only three years old and did not study with the Third Prince in one place.
In the novels, 80% of the pre-existing villains are taken up by the party of the Three Princes, and in reality, those events are separated by as many as a few years or as few as a few weeks.
As the Third Prince's attendant reader, it was simply impossible for Xue Yao to casually meet the cub-stage Long Ao Tian.
Now, the more feasible way out is to find something good to do, brush up some "whitewash points", and see what kind of goodies can be exchanged.
So for the next week, every day after Xue Yao returned from the Shangshu's office, he put on all his energy and wandered blindly around the inner and outer courtyards of the Xue Mansion, praying that the patriarchs and the elders would encounter some kind of trouble and wait for him to come to their rescue.
However, he was only an eight-year-old child, unable to carry on his shoulders or hands, unable to do any physical favors, and his state of mind was not up to the level of solving problems for mortals.
The last favor he did was when a servant in the courtyard cut her hand, and he took the ointment from his room and treated the servant's wound.
Whitewash Points +2.
Just by the pettiness of this system it seemed that he wouldn't be able to earn 50 points even if he donated all of his private items!
*
This morning, the old lady of the Xue family wanted to go to the temple and only let the daughter-in-law of the eldest house, Wang, accompany her.
Xue Yao followed his father and sent the old lady all the way out of the Xue Mansion.
When the old lady got on the bus, her legs were not too nimble, and she lifted her feet three times before she stepped on the stirrups.
This scene suddenly sparked Xue Yao's memory!
In the novel, the third prince once went to catch the young male lead, found that the readers Xue Yao was not around, asked the little eunuch, only to learn that Xue Yao's grandmother at home had an accident and went back on leave.
The third prince and the readers have a good relationship, but also deliberately asked a couple of sentences, and then learned that Xue Yao's grandmother went to the temple to worship Buddha fell, hip bone to break.
Shortly after this incident, Xue Yao in the book took a few more days off, because her grandmother had died.
The exact amount of time between the fall and her death is not written in the book, but Xue Yao believes that the fall, directly or indirectly, led to Mrs. Xue's death.
Ancient medicine was not well developed, and when you broke a bone in your sixties, it took months of recovery time and you had to stay in bed.
As you get older, lack of moderate exercise can find its way into any illness.
If all of the above inferences were valid, then if Xue Yao stopped the old lady from going to the temple now, it would be tantamount to saving someone's life, and he should be able to get quite a few whitewash points.
But how is he going to stop the old lady from going to the temple to burn incense?
Because the old man has been suffering from frequent headaches lately, the old lady is going to donate incense money to the temple because she can't find out what's wrong even if she invites a bone-setter to come.
If Xue Yao were to stop this kind of thing, it would be a great unfiliality, and he would not be able to work in the Xue family in the future.
What's more, the third master of the Xue family has the least status at home, the first son of Xue Qiong is still not valued, he is a commoner son, a person with a small voice, no say at all.
The old lady got into the car, Wang had followed her in, and the boy was about to collect his stirrups when Xue Yao suddenly stiffened and rushed forward, shouting, "Old lady! I also want to go to the temple to worship the Bodhisattva!"
The child's clear voice roused everyone's attention, and the more than twenty pairs of eyes present looked in unison at the second son of the third house family, Xue Yao.
The carriage's mantle was lifted, and the old lady asked Wang, "Which family's child?"
"It's Yao Ge'er." Wang replied.
The old lady shouted outward, "There's nothing interesting in the temple, and you won't be able to stay there if you go."
"I don't want to play, I want to worship the Bodhisattva!" Xue Yao quickly ran to the back of the carriage, stretched her neck and looked at the old lady with wide, watery eyes, "I want to accompany the old lady to worship the Bodhisattva together, so that Grandmaster won't have a headache!"
The old man is in love with hearing children's unintentionally auspicious words, the old lady was beaming with joy when she heard it, beckoning, "Carry him up here, it's rare for a child to have this intention."
The servants on the side immediately carried Xue Yao onto the carriage, and he went to the temple with the old lady so smoothly.
Xue Yao's own father was stunned, not expecting his normally obtuse youngest son to suddenly let loose and kiss such a loud ass without any pretense!
After returning, Master Xue repeatedly lamented and praised Yao'er for being a good worker with an immeasurable future.
Mrs. Chen heard and did not dare to refute, only gentle smile, after all, she can not in front of the master's face can not tolerate the commoner son out of the limelight, the heart only hated that Aunt Zhou really will be tempered son.
*
Xue Yao followed the old lady to the temple, and from the moment he got out of the car, he had the cheek to hold on to the old lady's arm for dear life, all the way along.
Mrs. Wang politely mentioned several times that it was hot and wanted Xue Yao not to walk close to the old lady, but Xue Yao just pretended not to hear it and said, "The old lady walks slowly", and "Carefully in front of the threshold".
The Xue family is a large family, and even if they live in the same house, there is still a distance between the grandchildren.
Although the old lady did not care too much about the distinction between the first and the concubine, the original master Xue Yao was mute and lacked active means of socializing, thus the grandparent-grandson relationship with the old lady was very thin.
This sudden intimacy was actually quite abrupt, and anyway, Xue Yao flattered himself so much that he kept his face red, in order to clear his points.
Unexpectedly, the old lady did not feel embarrassed, but rather happy.
The Xue family is a family of poetic and ritual hairpin tassels, and their children and grandchildren are all scholars, emphasizing "a gentleman is more sensitive to his words than to his deeds".
From Elder Master Xue to his three sons, and even the five young masters of his grandchildren's generation, they would never act overly intimate with the old lady like Xue Yao did.
It is the daughter-in-law and granddaughter who are more attentive to the old lady, so the old lady loves to play with the female family members in one place on weekdays.
Now it is rare to have a grandchild stick to her like this, the old lady's heart gave birth to a different kind of sweetness, naturally not afraid of the heat of the day, just happy to stick with the little grandson to walk together!
That's why Wang's nagging was so hard, and she was even glared at by the old lady and didn't dare to say more.
Xue Yao heart is actually not bottom, thought the old lady is not open face did not push him away, so has not dared to raise his head and the old lady to meet the eyes of the old lady, vainly drilled in the old lady arm, but appeared to be more and more sticky.
Xue Yao in the original is an eighteen line cannon fodder, the text has no positive portrayal of his old lady wrestling, Xue Yao is not at all sure when the old lady will wrestle, so he is always on guard and does not move an inch.
When the burning of the incense was finished, Xue Yao encountered a problem - the monk who interpreted the sign wanted to take a step to talk to the old lady, saying that there was something he needed to tell her alone.
The two of them then went to the pond behind the monastery and talked about things as they walked.
Although he had dismissed his subordinates, he did not specifically allow the servants to watch Xue Yao.
Xue Yao immediately slipped away to the back garden of the monastery and peeked behind the rockery to watch.
The monk and the old woman strolled along the gravel path on the periphery of the pond, and as soon as Xue Yao took one look at the pavement, he knew it was going to be the end!
It rained last night and the mud puddles on both sides of the pond gravel road were washed out by the rain, and a lot of the gravel road was muddy and slippery at first glance.
100% is in this place fell, Xue Yao want to rush up to help the old lady, but this is also too inexplicable, offer attentiveness also have to have a degree, too much will cause people to be annoyed.
There was nothing for him to do but hide behind the flowerbed and stare intently at the path in front of the old woman.
When the old lady walked to the west side of the pond, Xue Yao suddenly saw some reflections on the gravel road in front of her, and when she fixed her eyes on it, she realized that it was a puddle of sunken pavement, with standing water in it.
Looking back, the old lady was listening to the monk's speech with rapt attention.
Eighty percent of them fell here!
Without hesitation, Xue Yao darted around the back and watched from a distance of four paces behind the old woman as she stepped into the puddle of stagnant water!

Xue Yao was finally released from the court and regained his freedom.
That night, the people of Ping Rong County held a festival in the mountains to pray for Xue Yao.
Lu Jinan had the Minister of the Household join him in this sacrifice.
"You said that there must be a conspiracy behind Xue Yao's willingness to be a junior companion all these years."
Lu Jinan stood under the tree, looking at Xue Yao not far away, surrounded by the common people in the center, and softly said, "Then you can see clearly now, this is Xue Yao's 'backstabbing plot' all these years. A few years ago, Xue Yao disregarded his own safety, controlling the epidemic and removing the plague, saving hundreds of thousands of people in Ping Rong County and even the two neighboring counties, so these powerless commoners treat him as a living god, as a regenerative parent. If he truly has the ambition you speak of, why doesn't he spend this life-threatening strength on befriending the powerful and wealthy?"
The Minister of the Household looked blankly at Xue Yao who was surrounded by the people not far away, and after a long time, his knees bent and he fell to the ground, bowing down and confessing his sins.
After the festival, the villagers celebrate with a feast around the fire.
Although he escaped from death, Xue Yao still had something in mind that he couldn't let go of, and he sought an opportunity to get out of the crowd and find the old Zhang family's son to ask--
"What I asked you to convey to the officials the other day hasn't been done yet, has it? If you haven't done it, you don't have to." Xue Yao thought she was dead that day and planned to trick Lu Qian into moving on.
If this letter is really sent to the capital, the lemon cubs will have to blow up in anger.
The old Zhang family's son's eyes lit up and he told Xue Yao in a particularly dependable manner, "After Your Excellency was rescued that day, I immediately relayed Your Excellency's orders to the magistrate, so please don't worry about Your Excellency!"
Xue Yao: "......"
Your benefactor is afraid it's over.
"Eun Gong, have another bowl of wine!" Old Zhang's son was kind enough to urge him to drink.
"No, I've got something to do later."
"Tonight? What else is there to do with the Benefactor?"
"Eh ......" Xue Yao twisted her head and looked around, intending to use Lu Jinan as a shield.
In the instant that his vision flowed, Xue Yao abruptly realized that not far away, there were villagers gathered around, and amongst the villagers stood a slender profile that stood above the crowd, with a red-gold bundle of crowns and a dark purple long shirt.
The figure stood between the villagers very abruptly, and very familiar, so familiar that Xue Yao some legs soft ......
Why is the lemon cub here!
You came here to take revenge because of the "cheating letter"?
Xue Yao sheepishly took two steps back, intending to go find Lu Jinan to help explain the proof.
However, as if Lu Qian had sensed his intention to escape, he leisurely turned his head towards him.
Xue Yao is ready to die.
The moment his eyes landed on Xue Yao's face, Lu Qian suddenly revealed a clear and innocent smile.
The smile was so cheating that it made Xue Yao lose his desire to live.
Lu Qian opened his long legs and quickly stepped closer, squinting and smiling at Xue Yao, "At the risk of asking, are you a local?"
"Huh?" Xue Yao was confused.
Did this lemon cub lose his memory because of a vinegar explosion! Why don't you recognize him?
Lu Qian lowered his head and cleared his throat, picking his eyes to look at Xue Yao, and said with a serious look, "Master is a son of a family from Jiangnan, and just now in the crowd, you looked at each other, and felt full of admiration."
"You ......" Xue Yao realized that Lemon Pup was acting out that "cheating letter" in which he fell in love at first sight with the "son of the Jiangnan family". ".
What kind of fresh revenge is this?
Xue Yao decided not to go along with Lemon Pup's script.
With a serious look on his face, Lu Qian continued to say to Xue Yao, "Can Master buy you a cup of milk?"
Xue Yao stifled a laugh and rolled his eyes, "I can't."
Lu Qian frowned seriously, "I hope you'll seriously consider this, Master is the freshest son of the family in Jiangnan."
Xue Yao: "......"
The night before leaving the capital, he teased the lemon cub that he did not like bamboo horses, like love at first sight, that is fresh.
Also Jiangnan "the freshest" son of the family, this guy is definitely the capital's first vindictive cub!
Xue Yao cried and laughed: ''Your Highness is addicted to acting? When exactly did you come to Ping Rong County? Why didn't you come to me earlier, I'm all ......"
"Don't move!" Lu Qian suddenly came close to Xue Yao's face and scrutinized it.
Xue Yao raised an eyebrow, "What's wrong?"
Lu Qian narrowed his eyes and sighed in a pretense of sophistication, "Master see you cicatrizes phoenix eyes, is the phase of the princess."
Xue Yao was at her wits end with this naughty cub and didn't respond, waiting for Lu Qian to finish his act.
Lu Qian face expectant, waiting for the watery little companion to remember the fiancé far away in the capital, and then conscience, refused to see this "Jiangnan wanderer", so that the cheating letter is invalidated.
However, Xue Yao did not cooperate at all with His Highness's words.
Lu Qian lost his eyes and lowered them, but still persistently muttered in a small voice, "This face of yours is extremely rare ......"
Seeing Lu Qian's lost look, Xue Yao was silent for a moment, took a deep breath, and suddenly turned around with a surprised expression, matching the cub's script, and said excitedly, "Really? I have the look of a princess?"
Lu Qian immediately revitalized his spirit and raised his head to reply, "Master never misses a beat when it comes to looking at people."
Xue Yao laughed in surprise, "Then Gongzi quickly show me! Where is my husband?"
Lu Qian stared solemnly at Xue Yao for a while and announced in a deep voice, "Your good match is now living in the palace, this is the will of heaven, it seems that a Jiangnan mortal like Master has no chance to own you."
"My husband lives in the palace?" Xue Yao raised an eyebrow and snapped her fingers, "It wouldn't be the most handsome prince from the east of the southern three houses, would it? I admire him the most!"
Lu Qian lowered his head and smiled, picking up his long eyelashes to look at Xue Yao.
For the first time the joy of the lost and found showed in his eyes, the kind of joy that carries with it a sadness that has not yet dissipated.
After a moment's pause, Lu Qian replied in a low voice, "It's him, you can only marry him in this life."
Xue Yao's eyes slowly widened, and she raised her hand to cover her mouth in surprise: "Oh my god ...... do I have this honor?"
Lu Qian was amused by the silly Yao Yao, and again hastily nodded with a serious look.
The laughter of the people around them blended with the evening breeze.
The smiles of these two boys eclipsed the beauty of the evening.
Lu Jinan stood not far away, watching his seventh brother play and laugh with Xue Yao, a smile gradually surfacing in his eyes.
It turns out that such a wonderful fit can happen between men.
